title: WHO: HIV and AIDS fell from the seventh leading cause of death in 2000 to the 22nd in 2023
summary: The causes-of-death sheet says HIV and AIDS deaths fell 62 percent and left the global top ten.
body: WHO's causes-of-death fact sheet says deaths from HIV and AIDS fell by 62 percent, from the world's seventh leading cause of death in 2000 to the twenty-second in 2023. The HIV fact sheet gives a 2025 death count. This card is the change in rank and the 62 percent fall, for 2000 to 2023, not the 2025 count.
